2026-08-06DNDNational Defence ActRegulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian ForcesRegulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian Forces in order to (1) provide that a victim has the automatic right to information about their case but has the choice whether to receive it; (2) repeal two articles in the Regulation which set out the procedure for witness testimony outside the courtroom since they are included in the amendments to the Act; and (3) replace the article that quotes the section of the Act regarding adjournment of court martials with a general reference to the relevant section of the Act.N/A
subject: Regulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian Forces
precis: Regulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian Forces in order to (1) provide that a victim has the automatic right to information about their case but has the choice whether to receive it; (2) repeal two articles in the Regulation which set out the procedure for witness testimony outside the courtroom since they are included in the amendments to the Act; and (3) replace the article that quotes the section of the Act regarding adjournment of court martials with a general reference to the relevant section of the Act.
